relationship_to_prior_study: New follow-up informed by the v2 results and reviewer critique; original protocol, artifacts and statistical family remain unchanged.
question: What does label-informed positive assignment contribute beyond promotion count, coarse frozen-score difficulty, and training schedule?

estimands.matched_schedule: Supported promotion minus source-only targets or randomized positive assignment, at each common learning rate, epoch and training seed.
estimands.selected_procedures: Complete condition-specific learning-rate and checkpoint selection strategies. Native and source-retrieval selection differ in criterion, relevance, candidate pool, direction balance and development set size.
estimands.not_identified: This study does not identify target redistribution as the cause of retrieval loss, independently visually adjudicated semantic truth, or the value of relation-label method families outside the specified adapter and objectives.

training.optimizer_and_adapter: Use the original ledger's complete hyperparameters, frozen encoder/features and score scale, zero-initialized independent 512-dimensional linear residual maps, AdamW and original normalization.
training.batch_order: Reuse original per-training-seed batch-order generator identically across every policy and assignment draw. Assignment randomization is independent.
training.save_epochs: Save weights at all epochs 0 through 10. Selected records reference saved files; do not copy weights unnecessarily.
training.training_data: Original 1200 training images and all their original source captions and hypotheses only.
training.test_use: No held-out outcomes enter fitting, selection, randomization design or hyperparameter choice.

controls.source: Original clip objective: only source captions positive; all hypotheses remain competing candidates at unit weight.
controls.supported: Original multipositive objective: source and supported hypotheses positive; all weights one.
controls.count_only: For each training image, uniformly choose exactly its original supported count from all its own annotated hypotheses. Five source captions remain positive.
controls.score_stratified: Within each image sort all own hypotheses by frozen cosine score, tie-break by global manifest text index. Split with numpy.array_split into two bins; lower-score bin gets the extra item if odd. Uniformly choose exactly the observed supported count within each bin.
controls.similarity: Cosine calculated in float64 from cached frozen image/text vectors with explicit L2 normalization. Bin membership does not use relation labels; supported-count quotas do.
controls.rng: numpy PCG64/default_rng for each independent assignment seed; process training images in original manifest order. Freeze each draw across all training seeds, learning rates and epochs.
controls.ownership: Assert each hypothesis text ID has exactly one owning image. Preserve positive count per row, eligible reverse-anchor count, candidate strings, and weights within every paired batch.
permutation_diagnostics: exchangeable versus forced bins and rows
promoted frozen-score mean and distribution imbalance
exact positive and reverse-anchor count checks
identity-level versus exact-string-level changed positive assignments
controls.interpretation: Label-derived quotas make these identification controls, not annotation-free deployed alternatives. Naturally unchanged assignments are retained; do not condition sampling on obtaining a change.
controls.target_budget: Uniform positive targets and original symmetric mean-log-probability objective for all four policy families. No alternative target-budget objective in this execution.
controls.preserve_original_labels: Store promotion assignments separately. Never alter evaluation labels or original manifest. Score bins and random assignments affect training only.

data.train: Unchanged original manifest and features; only original train split is fitted.
data.native_validation: Unchanged original100 validation images and all1875 validation caption/hypothesis IDs.

source_validation.name: e_vil_dev900
source_validation.selection: All1000 official e-ViL dev image IDs except the100 original calibration IDs; includes original100 validation images.
source_validation.relevance: Exactly five source captions per image, source ownership only; no hypotheses in candidate pool.

source_test.name: e_vil_test1000
source_test.selection: All1000 official e-ViL test image IDs; includes original400 test images.
source_test.relevance: Exactly five source captions per image, source ownership only; no hypotheses in candidate pool.
source_test.prior_exposure: Retain subgroup IDs for the original400 evaluated test images and the600 additional images. Full1000 is the declared endpoint; subgroup query summaries are descriptive and use the same complete candidate pool.

data.source_revisions: Use the unchanged pinned e-ViL, Flickr image, Flickr30k Entities and encoder revisions from the base protocol. Reuse identical cached features by exact IDs/strings and model provenance.
data.disjointness: Verify image ID and image-file SHA256 disjointness across train, calibration, dev900 and test1000. Record source-caption provenance, duplicate strings and any string overlap.
data.benchmark_name: e-ViL test-pool Flickr source-caption retrieval. Never label it standard Karpathy Flickr1k; that split overlaps the original training/validation data.
data.other_test_sets: Original VE400 relation test, SugarCrepe7511, SugarCrepe++4757 and COCO5000/25000 unchanged.

selection.native: Exactly original mean(validation source+supported I2T R1, image-balanced supported-vs-contradicted accuracy).
selection.source_retrieval: Mean of source-only e_vil_dev900 image-to-text R1 and text-to-image R1, both exact full pools.
selection.best_epoch: Per training seed maximize criterion over epochs0..10; earliest epoch wins ties.
selection.learning_rate: Per policy AND assignment draw maximize mean best score across three training seeds; lowest learning rate wins ties.
selection.random_draws: Select each draw separately and average the three draws equally. Never select a best assignment draw.
selection.frozen_reference: Eligible epoch0 uses the same initial state and normalization as the base study.
selection.output: state_manifest.json holds all792 state references; selection references their hashes without duplicating state files.

evaluation.source_test: Score full e_vil_test1000 on primary, trajectory and both selected-strategy states, plus frozen.
evaluation.relation_and_composition: Score unchanged VE400, SugarCrepe and SugarCrepe++ on primary, trajectory and both selected-strategy states, plus frozen.
evaluation.coco: Score COCO only on all epoch10 states and unique states selected by native or source_retrieval, plus frozen. No requirement for additional epoch1/5 COCO trajectory states.
evaluation.deduplication: Score identical checkpoint state references once; never count reused selected/trajectory states as independent replication.
evaluation.numerics: Original float32 adapter forward/final normalization, float64 similarity accumulation, stable candidate-manifest-index retrieval tie-breaking; original relation half-credit and triplet strict comparison.
evaluation.artifacts: Bind protocol, code, manifests, feature and checkpoint hashes before scoring. Retain per-query ranks and best-relevant indices/scores, full relation/triplet item scores and correctness; top-k retrieval lists may be omitted.
evaluation.reporting: Report each LR and all specified cells. Do not pick an LR, epoch, draw, direction or selection strategy using test outcomes.

primary_analysis.aggregation: Average assignment draws equally within training seed, then average the three seeds within each query. Reuse the three actual supported fits; do not pretend they are nine independent fits.
primary_analysis.bootstrap_unit: Paired image clusters. For text-to-image, retain all five source-caption queries in their owning image cluster.
primary_analysis.interval_scope: Image-bootstrap intervals condition on the trained seeds and assignment draws. They do not quantify population uncertainty over new training runs or label randomizations.
primary_analysis.uncertainty_reporting: Report all training-seed and assignment-draw cells, per-draw means and per-seed means, alongside conditional image intervals.
primary_analysis.secondary: All COCO, VE, SugarCrepe, SugarCrepe++, non-R1 source metrics, trajectories and selected-strategy contrasts are descriptive. No extra confirmatory labels or equivalence claims.

verification.implementation: Meaningful control invariance tests and matched original source/support replay checks before publication of new results.
verification.replay: All18 source/supported fits must reproduce original training losses/native validation histories and best-state tensors exactly at their original best epochs, or stop and explain any discrepancy before using matched results.
verification.before_training: Bind original inputs, completed dev900 features, protocol, assignments, new implementation and original imported source hashes in an immutable execution ledger.
verification.before_evaluation: Bind complete test inputs and all planned checkpoint references in an immutable scoring receipt.
verification.preservation: Do not overwrite frozen base artifacts. Save small code/protocol/results checkpoints and push coherent follow-up updates to a dedicated GitHub branch.

future_work: Target-budget interventions, negative-weight sensitivity and a second model/adapter are not executed in this protocol. Their necessity will be assessed after the planned controls.
